description: Extract profile info and video grid from a TikTok profile page as structured JSON (name, handle, bio, followers, following, likes, videos[{videoUrl, views}]). Navigate to tiktok.com/@username first. Scroll down to load more videos in the grid. Use this to audit a creator profile or collect video URLs for further processing.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_extract_tiktok_profile
